title: Min4craft 4x4
description: Small Minecraft 4x4 slightly lighter more FPS because of small textures. For people who enjoy small Minecraft
body:
### What to expect

**What it does**

Min4craft is a tiny simplified 4 pixel style resource pack that shrinks Minecraft’s textures down to a super minimal look. It keeps the game recognizable while giving it a bold, clean, low detail style.

**Why you might want it**

You might want to try Min4craft if you like low resoulution or just want Minecraft to look simple and lightweight It doesn’t change gameplay,

**Other information**

Pack is not fully finished there is still A few bugs

| Category | 16×16 Minecraft | 4×4 Min4craft |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Detail | High detail, clear shapes | Extremely simplified, minimal shapes |
| Color Variation | Many shades per block | Very few shades, flat colors |
| Block Recognition | Easy to identify | Some blocks look similar due to low detail |
| Item Clarity | Items have defined outlines | Items may lose detail or hard to identify |
| Performance | Normal performance | Slightly lighter due to tiny textures |
| Style | Classic Minecraft look | Minimalistic, experimental |

This part was added to tell you what to expect and what changes, so you know what changes  before using the pack.

### Don't waste time  
What wasn't changed Fire, Lava, Chest, Ender Chest, Entities

| Texture | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Fire | Not changed due to A error while changing texture |
| Lava | Not changed due to A error while changing texture |
| Chest | Didn't get changed even when edited texture |
| Ender Chest | Didn't get changed even when edited texture |
| Entities | Didn't change |

This part was made to show you what wasn't changed so you don't waste time fixing something that was never edited, so don't waste time checking if your the on wrong version.
